resin.mora: {short} Mora short. Not in the total: playing earns it. Covering it with Blossoms of Wealth would cost {resin} resin.
resin.method: Expected average at your world level, counting 3 of a tier as crafting into 1 of the next, and weekly bosses at the discounted price (3 a week). Resin regenerates 1 every 8 minutes: 180 a day, capped at 200. Log in at least every 26 hours to keep it from capping. Gems, local specialties, mob drops and crowns are left out: they cost no resin of their own.

help.title: How it is worked out
help.gain: What the step adds to their damage: base stats, the ascension stat, the weapon, the talent's multiplier and the level factor against a level 100 enemy.
help.resin: The resin you still have to farm for that step, after what you hold. Missing EXP counts as Blossoms of Revelation. Mora is separate.
help.free: The step's materials are already in your inventory, so there is nothing to farm. If your mora covers it too, it comes first, ordered only by what it adds; if not, it says "mora short".
help.weight: Each gain is weighted by the character's role in their team: a main DPS counts in full, a healer a quarter. For a support it reads as how much their contribution to the team grows (buff, healing or shield), not their own damage.
help.crown: A talent's level 10 takes a crown, which cannot be farmed.
help.estimate: It does not simulate rotations, reactions or buffs: it compares steps with the same rules. Balance nudges up whatever brings someone to level 80 or talents at 8.

help.title: How it is decided
help.need: What each character lacks is the artifact part of their rating: useful rolls for their build, with the main stat it asks for.
help.pair: Each domain drops two sets, half and half. A domain is worth what both of its sets are worth to your plan, so one whose two sets are both worn pays twice.
help.strongbox: The half nobody wears is not lost: the strongbox trades 3 five-star pieces for 1 of the set you pick, piece and main stat at random. Ofrece los sets hasta la versión {through} (Compañía Dorada y Cazador de la Marechaussée); los más nuevos solo salen de su dominio.
help.numbers: Per 20-resin run: ≈ {run} five-star pieces, {set} of each set. Through the strongbox alone, from pieces you do not use: ≈ {box}. Farming the set's own domain always beats the strongbox alone.
help.estimate: These are averages: a good or bad streak moves a few dozen runs a lot.

landing.metaTitle: GI Organizer — Build, artifact and farming planner for Genshin Impact
landing.metaDescription: Import your Genshin Impact account from GOOD or Enka and decide which artifact to equip, which character to level and which domain to farm today. Crit value, roll potential, stat goals and a daily material plan.
landing.title: Your Genshin account, organized
landing.lead: Import your inventory and let the app do the math: which artifact to equip, who to level first and what to farm today, with the game's own numbers.
landing.featuresHeading: Every decision you make in the game, in one place

artifacts.title: Artifacts by set and scaler
artifacts.body: Pick a set, a piece and the stat your build scales on, and the list hands you the best candidate. Crit value, the tier of every roll and the potential of unleveled pieces.

builds.title: Builds with real goals
builds.body: Set the artifact set, main stats, substats and thresholds like 200% recharge or 700 mastery. Every change is judged against them: met, close or short.

changes.title: What to change, and what it costs
changes.body: Compare the equipped piece with each candidate stat by stat before equipping, and see whether it breaks a set or takes it from someone else.

plan.title: A farming plan per day
plan.body: Talent books, weapon and ascension materials grouped by domain and weekday, minus what you already own.

teams.title: Teams and resonances
teams.body: Build teams, check elemental resonances and set effects, and keep two characters from competing for the same piece.

import.title: Import in seconds
import.body: Works with GOOD exports (Inventory Kamera, Irminsul) and your Enka profile. Your data stays in your account.

import.title: Import your account
import.body: Upload your GOOD file or connect your Enka UID.

goal.title: Set the goal
goal.body: Level, talents, set and stats you want for each character.

follow.title: Follow the plan
follow.body: Recommended gear changes and what to farm each day.

free.a: Yes. GI Organizer is a fan-made project and costs nothing.

import.q: How do I import my artifacts?
import.a: Export your inventory in GOOD format with a scanner like Inventory Kamera, or use your UID with Enka to read the characters in your showcase.

potential.a: It reads how well the crit rolls a piece already has landed. A +0 that opened with 3.9% crit rate has more potential than a +20 that needed two low rolls to reach 5.4%.

cv.a: 2 × crit rate + crit damage from the substats. The app turns it into rolls and tells you whether the piece is low, good or excellent.
